_comment: Reviewed-good launchd surface (GOAL-5 AC2). Every com.renquant.* job's ProgramArguments is pinned here; the drift scan alarms on any divergence. Intentional changes update this file in the same reviewed PR.
_wrapper_scope_boundaries_comment: Wrappers this repo's drift scanner deliberately does NOT inspect, with the surface that owns each. Declared here because a scope boundary is a CLAIM that something else checks it -- changing one must take a PR. An unresolvable wrapper NOT covered by an entry below is reported as a PROBLEM, not an info line (codex on orch#675): otherwise a scheduled source can vanish from this checkout and become uninspected in silence.

com.renquant.daily104._evidence_glob_comment: the job writes a dated file per session; its StandardOutPath is a stale proxy and scoring it there produced a FALSE stale reading. Log dir verified to be used by this job ALONE (2026-07-30), so the glob cannot pick up another job's evidence.

com.renquant.intraday104._evidence_glob_comment: the job writes a dated file per session; its StandardOutPath is a stale proxy and scoring it there produced a FALSE stale reading. Log dir verified to be used by this job ALONE (2026-07-30), so the glob cannot pick up another job's evidence.

com.renquant.momentum-train-weekly._evidence_glob_comment: dated file per firing; StandardOutPath is a stale proxy for any wrapper that redirects (#627). This wrapper exec-redirects FIRST (the conditional-retrain silent-pre-exec-death lesson, orch#754 trail): every refusal lands in the dated log with an explicit REFUSED marker and every exit path writes a terminal marker, so log EXISTENCE proves the wrapper fired and log CONTENT carries the verdict.
com.renquant.momentum-train-weekly._schedule_comment: weekly, Saturday 05:00 (StartCalendarInterval Weekday=6 Hour=5 Minute=0 in ops/renquant104/com.renquant.momentum-train-weekly.plist). WHY THIS SLOT: the design fixes a weekly cadence aligned with the WF world; weekly-wf-promote and weekly-fundamental-refresh both fire Saturday 04:00 (read from the installed plists, 2026-08-02), so 05:00 trains over fresh Friday-close surfaces after that refresh hour -- and stays clear of Saturday 05:30, the slot the retiring weekly-retrain-patchtst still occupies until its #755 bootout grant executes, so the two grants stay uncoupled.

com.renquant.ops-audit._evidence_glob_comment: dated file per firing; StandardOutPath is a stale proxy for any wrapper that redirects (#627). Prefix unique to this job.
com.renquant.ops-audit._installed_comment: INSTALLED 2026-08-03 under the operator's 104/105 perfection directive (bootstrap verified; first hand-run produced a 10-finding report). The pending-install relaxation left tests/test_run_surface_drift_check.py in the same arc.

com.renquant.rq104-model-freshness._evidence_glob_comment: the wrapper writes one dated file per firing under logs/rq104/. Scored on that glob, NOT on StandardOutPath, because #627 measured StandardOutPath to be a stale proxy for every wrapper that redirects. Filename prefix is unique to this job, so the glob cannot pick up a sibling's evidence.
com.renquant.rq104-model-freshness._installed_comment: INSTALLED 2026-08-03 under the operator's 104/105 perfection directive. The #638 precondition was verified first (run checkout carries the executable wrapper); bootstrap verified; first hand-run reported a real freshness BREACH (rc=3). The pending-install relaxation left tests/test_run_surface_drift_check.py in the same arc.

com.renquant.rq104-silent-refusal._evidence_glob_why: A dated file per run. The exit code alone cannot separate 'found a silent refusal' from 'crashed' (#622), and an append-only .out cannot be dated at all (#663) — 0 of 18 lines in the drift scan's .out began with a date.

com.renquant.rq105-batch-scores-export._evidence_glob_comment: Derived from the job's own script, not guessed: renquant-orchestrator-run/ops/renquant105/run_batch_scores_export.sh writes $LOG_DIR/batch_scores_export_$TS.log. Without it this job has no per-job evidence surface, and launchd_liveness_scan falls back to a StandardOutPath shared with five other jobs -- unattributable, which is not the same as healthy.

com.renquant.rq105-postclose._evidence_glob_comment: Derived from run_postclose_loggers.sh, which loops MOD over [intraday_pairing_logger, entry_timing_shadow] writing $LOG_DIR/${MOD}_$TS.log. ONE module is declared, not both, because Python's glob does NOT expand shell braces -- a `{a,b}_*.log` pattern matched 0 files when measured, and would have reported this job stale forever. entry_timing_shadow is chosen as the LAST module in the loop, so its freshness witnesses the whole job. If it alone fails to write while the job runs, this reports STALE -- erring toward alarming, never toward false health.

com.renquant.rq105-quote-logger._evidence_glob_comment: the job writes a dated file per firing; its StandardOutPath is untouched, and scoring it there produced a FALSE '18-19 missed firings' reading — see the 2026-07-30 correction on issue #621
com.renquant.rq105-quote-logger._keep_alive_comment: GOAL-5 2026-07-22: reviewed intent — the installed plist must carry KeepAlive={SuccessfulExit:false} so a mid-session collector crash auto-restarts. ProgramArguments (the drift-scan-tracked surface) is UNCHANGED, so program_args_sha256 above stays valid and the scan stays green. Installing/reloading the new plist is a separate operator-gated machine-landing (see doc/progress/2026-07-22-rq105-reliability.md).

wrapper_scope_boundaries.why: 19 of 33 manifested wrappers live here, including daily104, intraday104 and weekly-wf-promote. The standing umbrella rule forbids WRITES and GIT there, not reads (#682) - so this boundary is an INSPECTED_BY claim: the drift scan reads each declared wrapper read-only every firing and runs the same fallback-idiom check as for local wrappers. Ownership of FIXES stays with the umbrella repo.
A pinned checkout materialised by the umbrella; its contents are governed by the pin, not by this repo's review.
